Join Our Team

Junior Full-Stack Engineer​

About Us:

ITsMine is a cybersecurity company that enables the sharing of sensitive data that’s scattered in multi-cloud environment. ITsMine solves this challenge using a fully automated solution with negligible false positives and without affecting employee productivity. 

We are a team of cyber security architects, knowledgeable hackers, industry leaders, and experienced software developers from top IDF cybersecurity units, backed by global VCs and investors.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for an AWESOME, curious and motivated frontend developer to be a part of our core R&D team and build a data protection SaaS platform the world needs! We care deeply about our work environment and encourage independence and innovation. An open-minded and highly-motivated developer would be a great part of the team.

What will you do?

As part of our core R&D team, you will work on this world-leading SaaS application. including designing and implementing web applications in Angular.

What experience or knowledge should you bring?

  • Experience with HTML5/CSS3 – required
  • Experience with JavaScript – required
  • At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience developing with Angular / React
  • Experience with typescript, ES6, redux – an advantage
  • Hands-on experience in developing complex Web apps
  • Ability to work in teams
  • Self-driven individual

Senior Backend Engineer

About Us:

ITsMine is a cybersecurity company that enables the sharing of sensitive data that’s scattered in multi-cloud environment. ITsMine solves this challenge using a fully automated solution with negligible false positives and without affecting employee productivity. 

We are a team of cyber security architects, knowledgeable hackers, industry leaders, and experienced software developers from top IDF cybersecurity units, backed by global VCs and investors.

What are we looking for?

The success of our business depends on the quality of our team. We work in a hybrid environment, and put team members first. The team includes both Backend and Frontend Engineers, writing in Java, using a microservice-based architecture.
We are looking for an AWESOME, curious and motivated backend developer to be a part of our core R&D team and build the data protection SaaS platform the world needs! We care deeply about our work environment and encourage independence and innovation. An open-minded and highly-motivated developer would be a critical part of the team.

What will you do?

In this role you’ll have end-to-end responsibility, from early stages of architecture design, through development, to delivering high-quality, fully-functional pieces of the ITsMine data protection solution. Shaping the infrastructure and the business logic that has immediate impact on the bottom line, using cutting-edge technologies, frameworks and innovative tools.

What experience or knowledge should you bring?

  • BSc in computer science or equivalent experience
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in using object oriented methodologies with Python / Java / or Similar.
  • At least 3 years experience in application design and development of cloud-based solutions.
  • Understanding of CI/CD and automation concepts.
  • Ability to solve challenging problems in a fast-paced and evolving environment while maintaining uncompromising quality.
  • Self-driven individual.

Advantages:

  • Experience with Dockers, Helm & Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with Azure and other cloud platforms
  • Experience with large scale management systems and performance
